name: The octopus has nine brains

hook_variants.template: One brain wasn't enough. This animal has nine.
What animal has nine brains, three hearts, and blue blood?
Nine brains. Three hearts. Blue blood. All in one animal.

sections.text: One central brain sits in the head. Eight more live in the arms.
Each arm has its own mini brain, about ten thousand neurons each.
sections.subtitle: brains: 1 central + 8 in the arms

sections.text: The arms can act on their own. They even react after being cut off.
sections.title: control

sections.text: That's why they can taste with their suckers and untie knots blindfolded.
sections.title: why it matters

sections.text: And the whole thing runs on a nervous system closer to a spider's than a fish's.
sections.title: Neuron count
sections.label: ~500 million neurons

sections.text: Follow for more facts that sound fake but are true.

facts.claim: Octopuses have a central brain plus a ganglion (mini-brain) in each of their eight arms
Octopuses have three hearts and copper-based blue blood
Octopus arms can act independently and react to stimuli even after being severed

titles: Nine brains, three hearts: the octopus
The octopus thinks with its arms
